player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Flytingin skal vera í forminum [macro micro] við tølum 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Hvør indeksur skal liggja millum 0 og 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: The micro_board, row, or col is out of range.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Spælarin má spæla í næsta mikro-bretti.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

game_action.played: Leikari {player_id} hevur spelt á mikro borði {macro_idx}, selli {micro_idx} (røð {row}, kolonna {col}). Leikari {opponent_id} má nú spela í {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Spælari {player_id} hevur vunnið Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
